name: Sekimori Gami
source:
In order to save money, the main character works at a store called "Gokurakudo" in a different world.

She will be working with a young doll called "Yoruichi" who works there, but....

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7533]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
为了省钱，主角在异世界一家名为​​“极乐堂”的商店打工。

她将和在那里工作的一个名叫“Yoruichi”的年轻娃娃一起工作，但是……
